sections.text_helper: Section 31.5.2 "Delay block SDMMC DLL status (DLYBSD_STATUS)" in chapter 31 (Delay block (DLYB)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1463.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x4
Reset value: 0x0000 0002
SDMMC DLL status register.
Bits 31:2 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 1 SDMMC_RX_TAP_SEL_ACK: SDMMC RX delay selection acknowledge
This bit indicates that RX delay line has been configured with the delay selected by
SDMMC_RX_TAP_SEL[5:0].
Bit 0 SDMMC_DLL_LOCK: SDMMC DLL lock
This bit indicates that DLL is locked to the input frequency.
